messages.subject: scaling legend sample points
parts:
Hello everybody,

Is it possible to change the size of the sample color splotches in the legend?

Here's a situation where you might want to do this (beware, this will
make a rather large pdf in your current working directory):

library(ggplot2)
quartz(height = 10, width = 20, file= "example.pdf", type = "pdf")
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = as.factor(cyl), size = 10))
p + geom_point() + scale_colour_hue("cylender")+ scale_size(legend = FALSE)
dev.off()

If you open the resulting pdf, you will see that the points on the
chart are size 10, but the points on the legend are still the default
size, (size = 2).

Is there any way to make the legend points the same size as the plot points?

Thank you,
Andrew

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: scaling legend sample points
parts:
Hi,

If size is a fixed number, it should be outside aes(),

p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = as.factor(cyl)))
p + geom_point(size = 10) + scale_colour_hue("cylender")+
scale_size(legend = FALSE)

HTH,

baptiste
